question.text: Which of the following strategies is NOT typically implemented by a Category III AIF under Chapter 10?

explanation.text: The Logic: Buyout (LBO) PE is Cat I/II territory (specifically Cat II PE funds). Cat III runs listed-market strategies (long-short, macro, arb, event-driven, market-neutral). Chapter 10 does NOT list buyout as a Cat III strategy. The Trap: Options B, C, and D (Long-short equity, Global macro, Convertible arbitrage) are explicitly named in Chapter 10 as Cat III strategies. Buyout/LBO is a private-equity glossary term and Category II includes Private Equity Funds. Note: Cat III strategies in Chapter 10 cover long-short, global macro, convertible arbitrage, and event-driven; buyout/LBO belongs to Category II PE funds.
